{{Top|leg}}
The [[Gigoran/Legends|Gigorans]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gigor/Legends|Gigor]] divided themselves into groups known as '''home-clans'''. These home-clans contained roughly fifty members, and were further divided into three to five family groups. Each home-clan was led by the most skilled hunter.

There was no higher government on Gigor than the home-clans, and it was a very unsettled and had no technology.

At some point during the [[Old Republic era|Old Republic]] or [[Rise of the Empire era|Rise of the Empire]] eras, [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] came to the world, but did not notice any of the shy Gigorans.

The home-clans of Gigor had no contact with the outside [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] until a group of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] made a base on the planet during the [[Rebellion era]] and sold many Gigorans to the [[Mytaranor Slaving Council]].
